ov: A genus of 23 species of sturdy, social monkeys. Apart from humans, macaques are the most widespread primates, from Japan to the Indian subcontinent, with the Barbary macaque in North Africa and Gibraltar. They mostly eat fruit and carry food in cheek pouches.

why.dg: Macaques bite and injure people in raids for food, and carry herpes B, rare in people but potentially fatal.

rg: Asia from Japan to the Indian subcontinent; the Barbary macaque lives in North Africa and Gibraltar.
df: Mainly fruit, plus seeds, leaves, flowers and bark; some also eat insects, shellfish and small mammals.
fx: Japanese macaques live farther north, and in a colder climate, than any other non-human primate.
A rhesus macaque named Tetra, born in 1999, was the first cloned primate.
